name: grupoLIBROS
description: Uruguayan online bookstore of the Grupo Libros chain with books in narrative, essay, children's, comics, cooking and poetry, plus gift cards. States delivery nationwide, with pickup at its stores.
description_es: Librería en línea uruguaya de la cadena Grupo Libros, con libros de narrativa, ensayo, infantiles, cómics, cocina y poesía, y tarjetas de regalo. Informa entrega en todo el país y retiro en sus locales.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Free pickup at Grupo Libros stores on request; email notice when ready

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Shipping page /envios also lists same-day express delivery in a mapped Montevideo zone.

sources.supports: books catalog, gift cards, account and help links
nationwide delivery, Montevideo and interior via DAC, pickup at stores
